Details of the portfolio 1. SEBI, vide circular no. SEBI/HO/IMD/IMD-II DOF3/P/CIR/2021/555 dated April 29, 2021, specified disclosures with regard to disclosure of (a) risk-o- meter of the scheme and the benchmark along with the performance disclosure of the scheme vis-à-vis benchmark and (b) details of portfolio, which were applicable from June 01, 2021. 2. Based on the representation received from AMFI, it has been decided to extend the implementation date of the provisions of the aforesaid circular to September 1, 2021. 3.
